title: Venue depth
description: How much can be traded on this venue without moving it. Spread is what a fill costs; depth is how big a fill it can take.

affirmative_spread.label: Up spread
affirmative_spread.description: The gap between the Up bid and ask on this venue, in dollars per contract. Wide means expensive fills.

negative_spread.label: Down spread
negative_spread.description: The gap between the Down bid and ask on this venue, in dollars per contract. Usually mirrors the Up spread.

affirmative_total_bid_depth.label: Up bid depth
affirmative_total_bid_depth.description: Total contracts waiting to buy Up on this venue. How much you could sell before running out of buyers.

affirmative_total_ask_depth.label: Up ask depth
affirmative_total_ask_depth.description: Total contracts waiting to sell Up on this venue. How much you could buy before running out of sellers.
